sourceRefs.locator: Object 10958: basalt, 260 cm high, early Preclassic 1200–900 BCE, Texistepec provenance and Patio 1.
pp. 16–18, Monuments from San Lorenzo and Adjacent Sites, item a: objects 1–5 assigned to the Cerro Cintepec and Soteapan basalt group.

note.de: Für das Objekt nennt der Museumskatalog etwa 1200–900 v. Chr. Die Karte zeigt die Fundstätte in San Lorenzo, die Fotografie das heutige Original in Xalapa.
note.en: The museum catalogue places the object around 1200–900 BCE. The map locates the San Lorenzo findsite, and the photograph shows the original on display in Xalapa.
